candidates.description: This vector represents concepts related to the Christian religion, its followers, and its institutions.

This vector represents quantifying determiners and indefinite adjectives denoting plural or partial quantity across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents temporal periods and units of time, such as parts of the day, days of the week, and seasons.
This vector represents consumable goods, organic items, and common household objects.
This vector activates tokens related to fear, sacredness, and royalty, often sharing specific lexical roots or prefixes.
This feature vector activates on tokens related to celebrations, festivities, and ceremonial events.

This feature vector represents dynamic action verbs denoting occurrence, motion, or transition.
